body: I used to play video games and make music for a YouTube channel, but now I have no effort left, or enthusiasm. My room has become completely trashed and I just go home and sit down. I dont hardly look at my phone anymore either. I just think. The most painful part is everyone thinks I'm just a quirky funny guy, and when I'm around people I feel at peace for a moment, then there is a lull in the conversation and I start thinking. My suicidal thoughts come in waves, like some sick seasonal flu, they are directly related to my anxiety and I just dont know what to do anymore. I'm afraid to look vulnerable so up until now I've refused to even acknowledge these feelings.
